content: Hello, I am Alder Credit's digital assistant. This call is recorded. Am I speaking with Mx Alex Rowan?
Yes, this is Alex Rowan speaking.
Before we continue, I need to ask two short security questions. What is your postcode?
What is your year of birth?

Thank you. I am calling about overdue payments on your account. Your credit card has 900.00 past due and is 4 days late. Your personal loan has 600.00 past due and is 4 days late. Your car loan has 450.00 past due and is 4 days late. Can you pay the full past-due amounts for all of these today?
Actually, I paid the card's overdue amount yesterday, and that personal loan isn't mine. As for the car loan, I won't be paying that.

Thank you. Payments can take up to two business days to show on your account. I have noted that. Let us go through them one at a time. Could you pay 450.00 for the car loan on Thursday 15 October 2026?
No, I won't be paying the car loan on Thursday.
Thank you for your time. Goodbye.
